title: Modestinus
summary: Raleigh names Modestinus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Modestinus, who comprehends the effects of the law in two. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter IV, §. XV, sig. 197b
